findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec in rich
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous operation that could lead to code injection or arbitrary code execution."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via eval/exec or unsafe deserialization

message.text: Potentially dangerous operation that could lead to code injection or arbitrary code execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection in subprocess or os calls
 * @description Using os.system or subprocess with untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pty").getMember(["spawn"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous command execution that could lead to command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via os.system or subprocess calls with untrusted input

message.text: Potentially dangerous command execution that could lead to command injection.
